name: Print With Smile
summary: Prague, Czech Republic brand selling PLA, PETG (including recycled and bicolor metallic), ABS, ASA and carbon-fibre-filled PLA, PETG and PA12 filament, plus a 'Plug&Play' 3D print-farm system. The legal entity and manufacturer are unconfirmed.

product_lines.name: Bicolor Metallic PETG
product_lines.notes: Co-extruded two-tone metallic-look PETG; no PETG silk/dual-colour id exists.

additional_notes: Company address is Prague 5. FUEL INVEST, SE filed the US PRINT WITH SMILE trademark in March 2022 for plastic 3D filament from the same district; recorded as suspected-parent-company. Manufacturer unknown. Listed as an MSV/IBVV fair exhibitor. No price evidence, so price_tier is omitted.

provenance.conflicts: Legal entity: FUEL INVEST, SE is the US trademark applicant (Justia record read 2026-11-06), with an address matching the exhibitor listing; recorded as suspected parent. EUIPO and the Czech register were not searched. Manufacturing origin unknown.

oem_relationships.notes: FUEL INVEST, SE (Societas Europaea, Vrázská 1562/24a, Praha 5, CZ 15300) filed the US mark PRINT WITH SMILE (serial 97318719, 2022-03-18, Class 17: plastic filaments for 3D printing) per the Justia record read 2026-11-06. The Prague 5 address matches the brand's IBVV exhibitor address. No statement that it operates the brand, so suspected.
